326d278.summary: Fires this card's own abilities and then its active enchantment abilities that match the given trigger. Called by the battle logic whenever a trigger event happens; runs each matching ability via TriggerAbility and returns true if any fired.
comments: Index into the card's active enchantments, used in the second phase below
Without a source card nothing can trigger (falls to the null-reference throw at the end)
Jammed cards ignore their own abilities unless this call is for an enchantment; no ability list also skips this phase
Phase 1: loop over the card's own abilities, skipped when only enchantments should resolve
Ask the ability whether this trigger, card and target satisfy its conditions
Ability has no multi-count criteria: fire it once
Multi-count ability: count targets and fire once per matching target (unless it targets 'any')
Collect all cards matching the multi-count criteria
Fire the ability once per found target (decompiler lost the per-target argument)
At least one ability fired
Ability did not fire; for a variable while-in-play ability this may mean its effect must be undone
Specific ability type (0xf0): condition no longer holds, so remove its extrinsic effects from the card
Phase 2: active enchantments on the card (also reached when phase 1 is skipped)
No enchantments, or caller said not to resolve them: return whether phase 1 fired anything
Rage trigger: log that rage enchantments are being played
Spent enchantments (already used up) are skipped
Enchantment holds a non-empty list of abilities: check each one
Debug log of which enchantment is being checked
Check whether this enchantment ability's trigger and conditions match
Also require the enchantment's quest counter to have been reached
Skip if this enchantment is the same one already handled by the special case just below
Special ability id 0x19a with trigger value 1: remember this enchantment so it fires only once per call
Fire the enchantment's ability, passing the enchantment and its count/size
Next ability of the same enchantment
Next enchantment
Shared exit of the compiler's null checks: some list or object was null
